ethercat._tx_layout_source: The nine-motor bench's servo host, read-only SDO survey 2026-09-14, CoE 22033/22034: fixed TxPDO 0x1B04 adds signed 32-bit 0x606C velocity_actual and 0x60F4 following_error, and drops 0x60FD digital inputs. On the nine-motor bench's servo host on 2026-09-15, physical PREOP readback verified the 0x1B04 assignment for all nine AS715N axes on the first attempt; the nine scanned-cache misses were resolved by the daemon's automatic rescan, with no mailbox retry during the mapping hand-off (docs/evidence/bench-ninemotor-2026-09-15/daemon-8deed804-b04.log:234-347,584-592); the kernel log contained neither 'wrong SDO' nor 'SDO configuration failed' (docs/evidence/bench-ninemotor-2026-09-15/dmesg-ethercat-8deed804-b04.txt:1-60). Owner decision 2026-09-15: 0x1B04 is the bench and robot default at 1000000 ns cycles; select a6ec_1b02 when wired drive digital inputs must be cyclic. Drive inputs on 0x1B04 are mailbox display observations; safety reactions belong to the hardware stop chain and cyclic cell I/O (P6-05). A6-EC manual chapter 11 (docs/drives/a6ec/a6ec_manual_chapter_11_parameter_list.md): 0x606C reference unit/s and 0x60F4 reference unit, i.e. counts/s and counts in the drive position frame; diagnostic observations only, never speed-safety certification.

encoder_battery_absent_alarm_tolerance._source: Measured mini bench 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-20: an intentionally absent encoder battery reports 0x603F=0x7305 with admitted 0x203F=0x0F90 (ALF9.0). coordinate_evidence._source: Owner-selected linear-mode source 2026-10-19: raw signed64 U40.20/.22 (0x2040:21/23), bracketed high/low/high to reject tearing; anchor identity version 3.
coordinate_evidence._acquisition_unverified: The nine-motor bench's servo host, sampled-412be4dd.log, 2026-09-13: measured two-upload acquisitions 56000000..83094896 ns (about 83 ms), uploads 24000000..44000000 ns, 0.60..0.67 samples/s/axis. Unverified bracketed acquisition_max = ceil((83094896 + 44000000)/1000000)*1000000 = 128000000 ns. Required age >= interval + N * acquisition_max + diagnostics + margin: 3000000000 = 1500000000 + 9 * 128000000 + 44000000 + 304000000 ns. Diagnostics and arbitration allocations remain unverified under contention. Checkpointed foreign uploads are outside this baseline sum: native-home truth refresh adds up to 9 * 44000000 ns, and startup and mapping readbacks can each insert an upload between sample opportunities. A refresh burst reaches 1500000000 + 9 * 128000000 + 9 * 44000000 + 44000000 = 3092000000 ns before margin; grace covers the resulting transient inhibit for idle axes without a fault if coherent recovery arrives within the bound. start_gap_ns and maximum_start_gap_ns publish sampling pauses. PDO history has ceil(age/cycle)+2 entries; PDO age remains one cycle. Missing, Unavailable, Cadence and Torn publications cannot replace retained valid evidence or renew its age. Sound Cadence/Stale samples with retained PDO history and bounded low-word skew are checked for contradictions in the receiving cycle. After age expiry, inhibit the affected axis with coordinate_invalid readiness and preserve Home for two sample cadences = 3000000000 ns; coherent recovery restores idle-axis readiness, longer absence or contradictory evidence latches the coordinate fault and requires rehome. Grace writes controlword 0; a moving axis fails closed with FaultDriveReadiness next cycle when the drive leaves enabled. Qualify bracket acquisitions, gaps and recovery on all nine axes.
coordinate_evidence._mode_contract: Owner decision 2026-10-19: C00.07=1 linear absolute mode with continuous 6064/607A and exact whole-count evidence.
coordinate_evidence._encoder_loss_signals: The listed 0x2040 absolute_feedback subentries expose positions only; no encoder-loss validity signal is available in this readback. In both evidence modes, statusword 0x6041 fault bit 3 and any nonzero error code 0x603F make readiness faulted without themselves invalidating coordinates or Home. The encoder-specific error code 0x7305 additionally invalidates coordinates and Home (GradientOS docs/resources/a6ec_manual_codes.md, A6-EC fault table: Encoder error). PDO discontinuity and contradictory encoder evidence still invalidate independently.
